data.one_liner: SessionStorage wrapper for web using an in-memory map fallback for other platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows manipulation of browser SessionStorage on the web platform while falling back to an in-memory map for other platforms. It uses a singleton pattern where instances share the same state.
use_when: You need a cross-platform interface that talks to window.sessionStorage on the web
You want temporary key-value storage that acts like a Map and does not persist past the browser session on non-web platforms
avoid_when: You need persistent local storage across app restarts on mobile or desktop platforms
You require complex querying or relational database features
strengths: Provides a unified Map-like API across web and non-web platforms
Shared static instance ensures state consistency across constructor calls
weaknesses: Non-web platforms only use an in-memory map, meaning data is lost when the app restarts
Very minimal feature set with no persistence support outside of the web's session storage

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides persistent key-value storage across all platforms instead of just an in-memory map fallback on non-web platforms.
